question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Rancid
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 3'** i.e. **'Fresh'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **'Rancid' **refers to (of foods containing fat or oil) smelling or tasting unpleasant as a result of being old and stale.(सड़ा हुआ)
 
• **Fresh-** Recently made, harvested, or collected; not stale or spoiled.(ताजगी) 
 
• **'Fresh'** is the** opposite **of '**Rancid**', making it the correct **antonym.**

Therefore, the** correct answer** is: **'Fresh'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

• **Urgent-** Requiring immediate action or attention.(अत्यावश्यक) 
 
• **Rough- **Having an uneven or irregular surface; not smooth or refined.(रुखा)
